Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Match components by SIZE, not by index
def match_components_by_size(comps_in, comps_out):
    """Match input components to output components by size"""
    if len(comps_in) != len(comps_out):
        return "Different number of components!"
    
    # Group input components by size
    in_by_size = {}
    for i, comp in enumerate(comps_in):
        sz = len(comp)
        in_by_size.setdefault(sz, []).append(i)
    
    # For each output component size, match to input component of same size
    result = {}
    for i, comp in enumerate(comps_out):
        sz = len(comp)
        result[i] = in_by_size.get(sz, [-1])[0] if sz in in_by_size else -1
    
    return result

def bfs_component(grid, start):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    visited = set([start])
    queue = [start]
    idx = 0
    while idx < len(queue):
        curr = queue[idx]
        idx += 1
        for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
            nr, nc = curr[0]+dr, curr[1]+dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and \
               grid[nr][nc] == grid[curr[0]][curr[1]] and \
               (nr,nc) not in visited:

def get_color_components(grid, color):
    """Get all connected components of a color with their properties"""
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(10):
        for c in range(10):
            if grid[r][c] == color and (r,c) not in seen:
                pixels = []
                stack = [(r,c)]
                seen.add((r,c))
                while stack:
                    cr, cc = stack.pop()
                    pixels.append((cr, cc))
                    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
                        nr, nc = cr+dr, cc+dc
                        if 0 <= nr < 10 and 0 <= nc < 10 and grid[nr][nc] == color and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                            seen.add((nr,nc))
                            stack.append((nr,nc))
                # Compute bbox
                rows = [p[0] for p in pixels]
                cols = [p[1] for p in pixels]
                maxr, minr = max(rows), min(rows)
                maxc, minc = max(cols), min(cols)
                components.append((pixels, maxr, minr, maxc, minc))
    return components

def get_components(grid, color):
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(10):
        for c in range(10):
            if grid[r][c] == color and (r,c) not in seen:
                pixels = []
                stack = [(r,c)]
                seen.add((r,c))
                while stack:
                    cr, cc = stack.pop()
                    pixels.append((cr, cc))
                    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
                        nr, nc = cr+dr, cc+dc
                        if 0 <= nr < 10 and 0 <= nc < 10 and grid[nr][nc] == color and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                            seen.add((nr,nc))
                            stack.append((nr,nc))
                rows = [p[0] for p in pixels]
                cols = [p[1] for p in pixels]
                comps.append((pixels, max(rows), min(rows), max(cols), min(cols), len(pixels)))
    return comps

def get_bbox_area(grid, color):
    comp = get_components(grid, color)[0]
    pixels, maxr, minr, maxc, minc, sz = comp
    area = (maxr - minr + 1) * (maxc - minc + 1)
    return area, sz
